shared: Serious institutional editorial identity portrait of a clearly non-human AI software role; restrained high-contrast monochrome paper-and-photographic collage; zinc-gray studio, white field and one very small Ember orange punctuation; centered head-and-shoulders profile composition; one role-specific geometric motif; premium annual-report art direction matching an editorial zinc grid. Keep the same camera, crop, light, background, material language and fine paper grain across the series. No text, letters, numbers, logo, photoreal human, skin, celebrity, robot, android, 3D render, cyberpunk, neon, blue, green, purple gradient, glowing eyes, fantasy armor, cartoon or stock-photo office. Square, opaque background.
negative: No readable or pseudo-readable glyphs. No extra colored accents. No UI, charts, screenshots, badges, labels, watermarks or signatures.
